description: This file defines the ECB class within the Opencart framework, specifically responsible for fetching and updating currency exchange rates from the European Central Bank (ECB). It extends the base Controller class, retrieves XML data from ECB's URL, parses currency rates, and updates the local currency data accordingly.

classes.name: ECB
classes.description: Controller class responsible for updating currency exchange rates from ECB

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Fetches daily currency rates from ECB, parses XML, and updates local currency values in the database
